title: Verbs: 好像, 以为, 算, 不用, 得 (děi), 来自, 要看
description: It seems, mistakenly thought, count as, no need to, must, come from, and 'it depends'.

points.title: 好像: it seems
points.summary: 好像 (hǎoxiàng) = it seems / looks like (an impression).
points.body:
- 他**好像**不太高兴.
- 外面**好像**下雨了.
examples: It looks like it's raining outside.

points.title: 以为: (wrongly) thought
points.summary: 以为 (yǐwéi) = thought / assumed — and it turned out wrong. Different from 觉得 / 认为 (simply think).
points.body: - 我**以为**他是老师，原来他是学生.

points.title: 算: count as, be considered
points.summary: 算 (suàn) + adj (+ 的) = it counts as / is fairly …; 还算 = reasonably.
points.body:
- 这次考试**算**简单的.
- 他的中文还**算**不错.

points.title: 不用: no need to
points.summary: 不用 (búyòng) + verb = don't need to. (不要 = don't!)
points.body:
- **不用**，我自己可以.
- 明天是周末，你**不用**早起.
examples: Tomorrow's the weekend — you don't need to get up early.

points.title: 得 (děi) + verb: must, have to
points.summary: 得 read děi = have to (spoken). Negative: 不用 (not ~~不得~~).
points.body:
- 太晚了，我**得**走了.
- 你**得**多喝水.
examples: It's late — I have to go.

points.title: 来自 + place: come from
points.summary: 来自 (láizì) + place = come from (a bit formal).

points.title: 这要看 … / 这得看 …: it depends on
points.summary: 这 / 那 + 要看 / 得看 + factor = it depends on ….

notes: 以为 needs a thought after it — 他以为不太高兴 isn't grammatical.
questions.translation: He doesn't seem very happy — what happened?

notes: 以为 needs a subject who thinks.
questions.translation: It sounds like it's raining outside — listen.

notes: 我好像他是老师 isn't grammatical.
questions.translation: I thought he was a teacher — turns out he's a student.

questions.prompt: What does 「{我|wǒ}{以为|yǐwéi}{今天|jīntiān}{是|shì}{星期六|xīngqīliù}。」 mean?
notes: 以为 implies you were wrong.

questions.prompt: {这|zhè}{次|cì}{考试|kǎoshì}（　）{简单|jiǎndān}{的|de}，{大家|dàjiā}{都|dōu}{考|kǎo}{得|de}{不错|búcuò}。
questions.translation: This exam was fairly easy — everyone did well.

questions.prompt: What does 「{他|tā}{的|de}{中文|Zhōngwén}{还|hái}{算|suàn}{不错|búcuò}。」 mean?

A：{要|yào}{我|wǒ}{帮忙|bāngmáng}{吗|ma}？
B：（　），{我|wǒ}{自己|zìjǐ}{可以|kěyǐ}。
notes: 好像 = 'it seems' — it isn't an answer to an offer.
questions.translation: A: Do you need help? B: No need, I can manage.

notes: 以为 = 'mistakenly thought' — 你以为早起 isn't advice.
questions.translation: Tomorrow's the weekend — you don't need to get up early.

questions.prompt: {太|tài}{晚|wǎn}{了|le}，{我|wǒ}（　）{走|zǒu}{了|le}，{明天|míngtiān}{还|hái}{要|yào}{上班|shàngbān}。
notes: 地 needs an adverb before it.
算 = 'count as' — 我算走了 isn't 'I must go'.
的 can't come before a verb like this.
questions.translation: It's late — I have to go, I've got work tomorrow.

notes: 以为 = 'thought (wrongly)' — it doesn't say where you're from.
questions.translation: My name's Anna, I'm from Germany.

questions.prompt:
A：{明天|míngtiān}{去|qù}{不|bu}{去|qù}{爬山|páshān}？
B：{这|zhè}（　）{天气|tiānqì}。
notes: 不用 = 'no need' — 这不用天气 isn't grammatical.
questions.translation: A: Are we going hiking tomorrow? B: That depends on the weather.

questions.prompt: What does 「{这|zhè}{得|děi}{看|kàn}{你|nǐ}{自己|zìjǐ}。」 mean?
notes: It's about 你, not 我.
